_note: Identical one-shot prompts for the Fable 5.2 vs GPT-6.2 Astra head-to-head. Same prompt, same empty worktree, no follow-ups.

tasks.title: Landing page
tasks.prompt: Build a single-file landing page called index.html (HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, no external dependencies except Google Fonts) for Orbit, a fictional AI scheduling app. Include a hero with a headline and call-to-action, three feature cards, a pricing table with three tiers, testimonials, an FAQ accordion and a footer. Make it fully responsive, polished and modern. Do not ask questions; finish it in one go.

tasks.title: Instagram carousel
tasks.prompt: Create an Instagram carousel as a single file called carousel.html: 7 slides, each exactly 1080x1350 px, stacked vertically with a 40px gap, on the topic '5 prompts that make AI write like you'. Slide 1 is a scroll-stopping hook, slides 2 to 6 show one prompt each with a short before/after example, slide 7 is a follow call-to-action. Use one consistent, bold, modern visual system with large readable type. No external dependencies except Google Fonts. Do not ask questions; finish it in one go.

tasks.title: Browser game
tasks.prompt: Build a complete browser game in a single file called game.html (canvas and vanilla JS, no dependencies): a neon space dodger. The player steers a ship with the arrow keys, WASD or touch, dodges asteroids that speed up over time and collects stars for points. Include a start screen, live score, a high score saved in localStorage, a game-over screen with restart, and sound effects made with the Web Audio API. Do not ask questions; finish it in one go.
